newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba confirms Russian journalist is expelled.
newsitem.headline: Cuba confirms Russian journalist is expelled.

text.p: The Cuban Foreign Ministry confirmed on Monday it expelled the correspondent in Havana for the Russian news agency Itar Tass, saying he was "directly involved in illegal activities related to gambling."

A ministry spokesman, Miguel Alfonso, said that Konstantin Zhukovski, 37, was ordered to leave the country after it was established he was linked with organising and promoting betting games, which are illegal in Cuba.

Alfonso, quoted by the Cuban news agency Prensa Latina, said the journalist had signed a statement acknowledging this. Zhuvovski had said his actions were part of journalistic research, Alfonso said, adding this could not be a justification.
Konstantin was detained in Havana at a private house on Thursday night and put on a flight to Moscow on Saturday.

Gambling was outlawed in Cuba after the 1959 revolution which brought President Fidel Castro to power. Illegal betting occurs, and Cubans convicted of gambling offences face jail sentences of up to four years.
